chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 389: The Third Forbidden Zone – A Fiendgod's Bow Fights Back
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning enters the final forbidden zone. A broken black bow defends a Fiendgod's corpse, firing arrows with Celestial Immortal-level power. Can he claim the treasure?
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 389: The Third Forbidden Zone
og_description: Ji Ning faces a broken bow that fights like a Celestial Immortal. The treasure is almost in reach.
twitter_description: A broken, stringless bow defends a dead Fiendgod. Can Ji Ning claim the treasure?

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme visualization technique from the goddess Nuwa's lineage. It fortifies the soul, aids recovery, and is one of the premier soul-nourishing methods in the Desolate Era world.
The supreme Fiendgod Body Refining divine ability below the True God level. It grants near-indestructibility and is trained through nine cycles of body refinement.
The body of a primordial being whose soul was so integrated with its flesh that residual will and killing intent can persist for ages after death.
A tier of magic treasure above Immortal-ranked, possessing immense power. Even damaged and without an owner, a top-grade Pure Yang treasure can fight at the Celestial Immortal level.
The highest tier of treasure in the Desolate Era setting, born from the natural laws of the primordial chaos. Possessing one is a game-changer for any cultivator.
A defensive sword art from the ninth level of the Divine Immortal Palace at Mount Innerheart, specializing in fluid, water-like defense.
